$comment: Programmable custom launch config. Fields marked TODO must be filled before submitting. Values here match the live v4 profile for Robinhood Chain as of 2026-09-17; re-check with `programmable-check --show-profile`.

profile.$comment: Bind the live profileDigest before packing. Read it from GET /v4/chains/4663/capabilities — a stale digest fails with PLAN_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.

token.name: {{TOKEN_NAME}}
token.$comment: totalSupply is a raw integer string, not a number. JSON numbers lose precision above 2^53.

compiler.$comment: Must match the platform toolchain exactly. A floating pragma changes the runtime hash and fails runtime_binding.

constructorArgs.$comment: poolManager is bound by the platform — do not hardcode it here or in source.

permissions.$comment: Must agree with getHookPermissions() AND the mined hook address bits. Bit positions are fixed by the platform manifest.

funding.$comment: Robinhood V4.1 requires a request-bound funding plan. valueWei is a raw integer string.

claims.$comment: This hook overrides the LP fee, which is a fee-behaviour claim. Capabilities currently reports feeBehaviorClaim:false — verify before submitting or admission rejects the claim.

disclosures.$comment: Anything programmable-check reports as a warning belongs here. Undeclared privileged controls attract review; declared ones usually don't.
